content: I found the belt tensioning difficult.  An audio app on a phone is overkill, and the spectrum is too detailed.  The article is confusing because power has not yet been applied at this step.  "Tight enough you can pluck the belt" was where I started, then once the new firmware was loaded I went through enough steps to get to the belt tuning calibration (the article says tuning wizard, but that doesn't exist here).  The first time it said I was an 1/8 turn off on both sides.  Doing that and trying again it said "you're good!".  But then homing failed to calibrate.  Since the upper belt frequency was lower than the bottom, I tightened it  more, then ran the tuning routine again.  It came back with "you're good!".  Homing calibration passed on the first try.  The upper and lower frequencies are very similar, so both belts vibrate and I had to look at the LCD to remember which one I was supposed to be measuring.  There are forum articles on why tension and homing go together.

replies.content: you do not seem to use the new builtin  belt tensioning method (without audio tools). Is much better.
